name: Hormonal receptive-state induction
summary: E2, progestin/PGR, cAMP and XAV939 establish the ADOC secretory/decidual state; mifepristone antagonizes PGR and strongly reduces adhesion.
evidence: direct ADOC plus conserved uterine biology
maboss: Keep protocol agents as explicit inputs; do not collapse them into a single hormone switch.

name: LIF-LIFR/GP130-STAT3 attachment gate
summary: Pre-attachment epithelial/glandular LIF activates GP130/STAT3 to remodel the epithelium and enable attachment; stromal LIF/STAT3 supports later stabilization.
evidence: replicated mouse genetics; human expression and cell-model support
maboss: Core candidate module; separate epithelial and stromal STAT3 where model size allows.

name: PGR-IHH-NR2F2-BMP2-HAND2 relay
summary: Progesterone induces epithelial IHH; stromal NR2F2/BMP2/HAND2 drives decidualization and restrains epithelial estrogen/FGF proliferation.
evidence: replicated mouse conditional genetics; human decidual support
maboss: Core cross-compartment relay; existing baseline already includes IHH, NR2F2 and BMP2; add HAND2 as first extension.

name: Epithelial anti-adhesive glycocalyx/barrier removal
summary: PODXL, full-length DAG1 and some MUC1 states create a non-receptive barrier; receptivity requires downregulation, cleavage or glycoform switching.
evidence: direct human gain-loss and biophysical studies
maboss: Use explicit inhibitory nodes. Split MUC1 barrier and MUC1 sLeX/glyco-permissive states.

name: Human epithelial adhesive surface effectors
summary: CD98/CD9, apical CDH1/CTNND1, ANXA2-RHOA-actin, SPP1-integrins and HB-EGF collectively form a receptive adhesive surface.
evidence: human mechanistic, biophysical and descriptive evidence
maboss: Prefer rate modifiers or redundant OR-gates, not a requirement that every effector be ON.

name: PCSK5 membrane and dystroglycan processing
summary: PCSK5/PC6 cleaves EBP50 and alpha-DAG1 N-terminus, reorganizing membrane-cytoskeletal interactions and releasing an attachment barrier.
evidence: direct human knockdown and cleavage studies
maboss: Represent PC6 -> DAG1_CLEAVED and DAG1_FULL as an inhibitor.

name: SPP1/OPN-integrin adhesion and decidual support
summary: Epithelial OPN supports interface adhesion while stromal OPN contributes to decidualization; integrin partners include alphaVbeta3/5 and ITGB1-related routes.
maboss: Keep epithelial and stromal SPP1 separate; anti-SPP1 neutralizes extracellular ligand rather than transcription.

name: Decidualization and dynamic senescence balance
summary: Decidual transformation and a controlled senescence/remodeling program create a dynamic implantation matrix; complete removal or excess dysfunction is unfavorable.
maboss: Use a balanced state or uncertain rule variant, not a simplistic senescence ON=bad rule.

name: TAZ-Hippo ECM remodeling and stromal mechanics
summary: TAZ/WWTR1 coordinates collagen/ECM remodeling; normal decidualization softens stroma, while excess ER stress prevents softening and reduces adhesion/expansion.
evidence: recent mouse genetics plus human mechanobiology
maboss: Add TAZ_ECM and Mechanical_Permissive_ECM; ER stress and excessive stiffness inhibit the mechanical state.

name: Cell-type-specific interaction candidates
summary: LGALS1, LGALS3, ITGB1, BSG and related interactions are receptive-phase candidates from compartment-resolved human RNA-seq.
evidence: human paired cell-type-specific RNA-seq plus in-silico interface inference
maboss: Expansion tier only; use for sensitivity analysis until perturbational evidence exists.

name: Embryo-conditioned feedback
summary: Embryo contact and hCG can induce CD98/CD9 and apical CDH1/CTNND1, stabilizing first contact.
maboss: Model hCG/contact as exogenous inputs because trophoblast is outside the current MaBoSS cell types.

name: Uterine WNT-Ca2+-integrin competence cue
summary: Uterine WNT5A/7A rapidly increases embryo alpha5beta1 trafficking and fibronectin binding through CaMKII.
maboss: Do not implement as maternal intracellular output in the core model; retain as external embryo-competence modifier or later PhysiBoSS interface field.

name: Physical microenvironment and transport
summary: Flow, oxygen, pH, temperature, ligand presentation and matrix stiffness can alter assay context, transport and tissue state, but direct adhesion-specific causal data are uneven.
evidence: project/NAM context plus mechanics papers; limited direct adhesion perturbation for temperature/pH/O2
maboss: Stiffness/ER stress may modify rates; temperature, pH, oxygen and flow should initially be boundary/QC variables or PhysiCell fields.
